11 days Central India wildlife tour

Delhi · Pench · Kanha · Bandhavgarh · Khajuraho · Agra · 11 days

11 days Wildlife tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Three of India's great tiger reserves — Pench, Kanha and Bandhavgarh — back to back, then the temples of Khajuraho and the Taj Mahal at sunrise.

At a glance

Duration
11 days, 10 nights
Start / end
Delhi / Delhi
Parks
Pench, Kanha, Bandhavgarh
Safaris
Up to nine jeep safaris
Transport
Private AC car, flight to Nagpur, train to Agra
Tour type
Private
Best season
October to June; best tiger sightings March to May

What makes this one worth it

  • Pench, Kanha and Bandhavgarh — the country that inspired The Jungle Book
  • Bandhavgarh, with one of the highest densities of tigers in India
  • Barasingha, the rare hard-ground swamp deer, in Kanha's meadows
  • Leopards, sloth bears, wild dogs, gaur and over 250 bird species
  • Khajuraho's UNESCO-listed temples and the Taj Mahal at sunrise

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Arrive in Delhi

    Our representative meets you at the airport and drives you to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours.

  2. Day 2

    Old and New Delhi

    A full day with your guide: Raj Ghat, Jama Masjid and the Red Fort in the old city, then Humayun's Tomb, Qutub Minar, India Gate and the government buildings of Lutyens' Delhi.

  3. Day 3

    Fly to Nagpur, first safari in Pench

    Morning flight to Nagpur and about two hours by road to Pench Tiger Reserve. Check in and head out on your first evening jeep safari.

  4. Day 4

    Pench safaris

    Morning and evening jeep safaris along the teak forests of the Pench river — tigers, leopards, wild dogs and rich birdlife.

  5. Day 5

    Pench to Kanha

    A last morning safari in Pench, then about five hours to Kanha National Park. Evening at the lodge.

  6. Day 6

    Kanha safaris

    Morning and evening safaris through Kanha's sal forests and open meadows, where the barasingha herds graze and tigers hunt.

  7. Day 7

    Kanha to Bandhavgarh

    A final morning drive in Kanha, then about five hours to Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve.

  8. Day 8

    Bandhavgarh safaris

    Morning and evening jeep safaris in Bandhavgarh, below the old hill fort — the park best known for tiger sightings in Central India.

  9. Day 9

    Bandhavgarh to Khajuraho

    About five hours to Khajuraho. The afternoon is free to rest after the early safari starts.

  10. Day 10

    Khajuraho temples, train to Agra

    A guided morning at the Western and Eastern group of temples, famous for their carving. Drive to Jhansi and take the afternoon train to Agra.

  11. Day 11

    Taj Mahal at sunrise, back to Delhi

    The Taj Mahal at first light and Agra Fort with your guide, then the expressway back to Delhi for your onward flight.

What the price covers

  • 10 nights in hotels and jungle lodges with daily breakfast
  • Private AC car and driver for all transfers and road journeys
  • Up to nine jeep safaris with park permits and a naturalist
  • Licensed English-speaking guides for sightseeing
  • Jhansi to Agra train tickets
  • Tolls, parking, fuel, driver allowance and taxes

What it does not cover

  • Delhi to Nagpur flight (we book it at cost)
  • Monument entry tickets
  • Lunch and dinner
  • Camera fees in the parks
  • Tips

Questions people ask

When are the parks closed?
The core zones close for the monsoon, from July to mid-October. March to May gives the best tiger sightings as animals gather at water.
How many safaris are included?
Up to nine — evening on arrival in Pench, then morning and evening drives in each park.
Is the flight included?
We book the Delhi to Nagpur flight at cost so you can choose the timing. Everything on the ground is included.
Can we add Satpura or Panna?
Yes. Both fit into this route with an extra two nights.
